label: رسمي
note: PlayStation Blog 17:15Z (Activision's Daniel Noel): MW4 Season 1 goes live 6 Nov, the first free content update: MP maps Backstab, Canyon, reimagined Shoot House at launch (Ministry, Overflow mid-season), Grind and Drop Zone modes, DMZ X01 weapons facility, Warzone maps Hajin and Zodiac, Cronen Osprey AR and CSG-35 SMG in the Season 1 Battle Pass (100+ items, catch-up to day 50). No start time in the post. Footage: Activision's Season 1 Launch Trailer, IGN 4K copy (16:08Z); rated blood and gore, shots checked at 3 fps full frame. No speech in the trailer.
